title: Inverse image commutes with scalar extension for internal modules
statement: Let g:Y→X be a morphism of schemes, R and S ring objects in abelian sheaves on X_proet, with R commutative, and φ:R→S a monoid-object morphism [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. For the monoidal inverse image g* and its module transport [sk-def-sfb-transport], there is a natural isomorphism g*_S ∘ Ext_φ ≅ Ext_(g*φ) ∘ g*_R. No finiteness, exactness or noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma 5.4.1 (inverse-image compatibility); the monoidal adjunction argument already used in BoundedConstructibleExtendScalars.lean

proof.text: Compose extension/restriction adjunctions with the monoidal inverse-image adjunction. The two right adjoints are naturally isomorphic: commute mapMod with comap, compose restrictions of scalars, and use naturality of the inverse-image adjunction unit on φ. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the displayed natural isomorphism.
